description: Draw a heatmap: a grid of cells coloured by value, with x and y categories (e.g. weekday × hour, product × region). For one cell per calendar day use generate_calendar_heatmap. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

data.description: One row per cell: {x, y, value}; x and y are category names or numbers.

name: generate_heatmap_chart
title: Heatmap
